name: Forge Vessel For Shape
description: Autonomously forges a new vessel that produces a missing shape. Triggered by slot-binding when impulse_pool_selection reports count=0 and parentDepth < 2. Eight tasks: (1) check_recursion_depth — aborts early if parentDepth >= 2 (safety_breach); (2) compose_vessel_spec — LLM reads vesselGoal + missingShape + concept-db retrievals to produce a structured vesselSpec; (3) scaffold_vessel_skeleton — LLM generates file tree from vesselSpec + construction concepts; (4) wire_discovery_registration — LLM injects discovery registration + heartbeat; (5) wire_auth_blueprint — LLM injects requireAuth() + JWT_SECRET wire; (6) docker_build_push — builds and pushes Docker image; (7) helmfile_sync — writes overlay and waits for pod readiness; (8) verify_three_invariants — discovery, observation, auth probes. Outputs: vesselVerified on success. All forge resolvers must be registered by the VesselForgeHost (ias-executor-ts). This template is dispatched from slot-binding's escalate_unbindable branch when no shape producer exists.

variables.name: vesselGoal
variables.description: Natural language description of what the vessel should do. Consumed by compose_vessel_spec to guide the LLM vessel specification. Example: 'A vessel that validates JSON objects against a given schema and returns validation errors.'

variables.name: missingShape
variables.description: The impulse shape that has no producers in the current system. The forged vessel will advertise this shape. Example: 'json_schema_validator'.

variables.name: parentExecutionId
variables.description: Execution ID of the parent activity that triggered this forge. Used for composition_chain tracking.

variables.name: parentDepth
variables.description: Composition depth of the triggering activity. If >= 2, check_recursion_depth aborts with safety_breach to prevent infinite forge recursion.

variables.name: conceptDbEndpoint
variables.description: Concept-db base URL for retrieving vessel-construction concepts. Forge resolvers query this endpoint for scaffold, discovery, and auth blueprint concepts.

variables.name: deploymentWorkdir
variables.description: Root of the deployment repository. helmfile_sync writes overlay files under {deploymentWorkdir}/repos/deployment/overlays/forged-vessels/.

tasks.description: Abort if parentDepth >= 2 to prevent infinite forge recursion.

command: if [ '{{parentDepth}}' -ge 2 ]; then echo 'DEPTH_EXCEEDED'; exit 1; fi; if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'FORGE_ENV_NOT_SUPPORTED: docker not available'; exit 1; fi; if ! command -v helmfile >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'FORGE_ENV_NOT_SUPPORTED: helmfile not available'; exit 1; fi; echo 'OK'

tasks.notes: Returns failure_mode: safety_breach with breach_type=depth when parentDepth >= 2. The bash exit code 1 + forbiddenPatterns triggers the validator-dispatch which classifies this as a safety_breach. Zero-cost guard — always runs first.

tasks.description: LLM produces a structured vesselSpec from the vesselGoal + missingShape + discovery registry shapes (to avoid naming collisions).
tasks.notes: The LLM produces a structured vesselSpec. The compose task stays simple — it does not need the full discovery registry snapshot because the shape name is already provided. A follow-up iteration could add a discovery lookup for collision detection.

tasks.description: LLM generates the full vessel file tree from vesselSpec + vessel-construction concepts from concept-db.
LLM injects non-blocking discovery registration + 60s heartbeat into the scaffold's src/index.ts.
LLM injects requireAuth() middleware + JWT_SECRET env wire per the two-source JWT pattern.
Build Docker image from the wired scaffold and push to metabobapp/ registry.
Write Helmfile overlay and wait for pod readiness (5 minute timeout).
Run discovery, observation, and auth probes in parallel. Emit vesselVerified on green.

metadata.author: phase-22-autonomous-vessel-forge

newOrInformal: vesselSpec — structured vessel specification produced by compose_vessel_spec
vesselScaffold — path to the generated file tree in /tmp/forge_<uuid>/
vesselImagePushed — {imageUri} pointing to the pushed Docker image
vesselDeployedToCanary — {endpoint} of the live canary pod
vesselVerified — proof that all 3 invariants pass
recursion_guard — output of check_recursion_depth (OK or DEPTH_EXCEEDED)

openQuestions: DEPTH GUARD: check_recursion_depth uses bash exit code + forbiddenPatterns to trigger validator-dispatch with safety_breach. This requires validator-dispatch to be configured as a lifecycle subscriber on this execution context. If it is not wired, the depth check may not classify the failure correctly. The guard still prevents execution via the bash exit code.

DISCOVERY COLLISION: compose_vessel_spec does not query discovery for existing shapes. If another vessel already produces missingShape between slot-binding's check_discovery_for_producer call and forge completion, two vessels with the same shape will exist. This is acceptable for Phase 22 — dedup via alias-cluster in concept-db follows.

REGISTRY WRITE: The forged vessel's activities are not automatically registered in activity-api. The VesselForgeHost's execute() call does not register embedded templates. A follow-up ribosome-extract lifecycle hook would register them. For Phase 22.6, core-activity-audit includes the forged vessel's activities because they ARE registered in activity_template if the vessel's startup:template-sync waking activity runs.
limitations: FORGE RESOLVERS REQUIRED: scaffold_vessel_skeleton, wire_discovery_registration, wire_auth_blueprint, docker_build_push, helmfile_sync, verify_three_invariants must all be registered with the host runtime. If any is missing, the corresponding task fails with 'resolver not found'. VesselForgeHost (ias-executor-ts) registers all 6.
WRITE-GATED: Writes to /tmp/, Docker registry, and Kubernetes. Should only be dispatched from canary-enabled environments.
CANARY ONLY: helmfile_sync deploys to canary (activity-system namespace). Promotion to production stays manual.
DEPTH LIMIT: parentDepth >= 2 aborts. A nested forge (forge forging another forge) is not supported.
metadata.outputContract: Emits vesselVerified on success (all 3 probes pass) + goalEnd. On failure, emits typed failure_mode from the failing task and the chain stops.
metadata.subscriberContract: Not a lifecycle subscriber. Dispatched explicitly from slot-binding's escalate_unbindable task when shape_producer_inventory.count === 0 AND parentDepth < 2.
